exposure: unplanned cesarean delivery (UCD) in the first stage of labor
larger fetuses (head circumference and body weight ≥90 centile)
unplanned cesarean delivery (UCD) in the second stage of labor
cohort: 7,635 term and preterm singletons born via UCD
finding: UCD in the second stage of labor was associated with larger neonates, persistent occiput posterior presentation, and a higher rate of maternal complications compared to UCD in the first stage.
mod_finding: UCD in the second stage of labor is associated with a higher rate of maternal complications compared to UCD in the first stage.
